text:
Eli: thinking about a compact Console "lane snapshot" widget for per-route insights — show lane label, tokens, cost/1k, p50, qps, 12-bucket sparkline. primary use: validate routing rule changes before rollout.
Sam: sounds good. where does lane info come from? router only emits chosen_model today.
Nisha: add optional lane_id + lane_label to router event. ingestion should accept null and map to "unknown".
Ben: prefer lane_id stable (uuid) + label friendly. telemetry team: materialize (route,lane,tenant) 5m buckets to serve UI fast.
Sam: agree on materialization. fallback: sample-based compute for routes without materialized view.
Eli: UX: default hide lanes <0.15% traffic, toggle to show. color by lane_id hash, sort by tokens desc.
Nisha: privacy: for Private deployments allow lane_label hashing per-tenant. add ingest flag to mask.
Ben: API: GET /routes/{id}/lane_summary?start=&end=&buckets=12 -> array of rows: lane_id,lane_label,tokens,cost_per_1k,p50_ms,qps,sparkline
telemetry-bot: deploy plan: router/lane_field/1733334600->staging, ingest/schema/1733335200->canary, materialize/1733338800->job, console/1733342400->ff/exp.lane_snapshot
Eli: follow-ups: (1) small RFC for event change + sample retention (30d), (2) design mock w/ color legend, (3) simulation feature as later ticket. Nisha: I'll draft RFC.
Ben: thanks — this should help PMs assess cost/latency tradeoffs pre-rollout. :thumbsup:
